full_judgment:
2. The defendant Railway, the petitioner here, contested the suit. Their case was that the plaintiff’s consignment was lost due to a theft committed in the running train between Gouripur and Mymensingh Railway Stations. The Railway Administration has taken due care of the consignment and there was no negligence and misconduct on their part. The learned Trial Court decreed the suit and the decree was affirmed in appeal. Being aggrieved the defendant-petitioner has moved this court and obtained the present Rule. 

 The Rule is accordingly made absolute. The judgments and decree of the courts below are set aside and the suit is dismissed. Parties are made to bear their own costs throughout.
